name: Galen's Fall
summary: Galen's Fall is a rocky cliffside hollow situated near Thoradin's Wall along the western edge of the Arathi Highlands. While currently an uninhabited pass between Arathi and the Hillsbrad Foothills, the rugged landscape sits adjacent to the disputed remnants of Stromgarde.

sections.title: Shadow of Thoradin's Wall
sections.body: Tucked against the eastern face of the ancient Thoradin's Wall, this pass borders the ancient lands of the Arathi basin and the road leading toward Hillsbrad Foothills. Today, it remains an austere stretch of rocky terrain and crags, largely quiet compared to the ongoing skirmishes tearing Stromgarde Keep apart just to the south. While travellers journey through the breach in Thoradin's Wall nearby, the slopes here remain exposed to highland beasts and wandering outriders.

faq.answer: Galen's Fall is located along the western border of the Arathi Highlands, hugging the base of Thoradin's Wall near the road connecting Arathi to the Hillsbrad Foothills.

faq.q: Why is the area named Galen's Fall?
faq.answer: The location shares its name with Prince Galen Trollbane, the living heir defending the ruined fortress of Stromgarde Keep against Syndicate interlopers and Boulderfist ogres.

faq.q: Is there a settlement or camp at Galen's Fall?
aliases: is there a town at galens fall
faq.answer: No. In the present day, there is no permanent encampment, fortification, or outpost built at Galen's Fall; it is an open expanse along the cliff wall.

angles.text: For Alliance loyalists trekking through Thoradin's Wall, these crags sit on the threshold of Stromgarde, where Prince Galen Trollbane still leads the beleaguered defenders of the realm.
Passing eastward from Tarren Mill through the wall puts Horde travelers in striking distance of Arathi, skirting the territory claimed by Stromgarde's royal guard.
